text: This roofer is good at his job. So why is his phone so quiet?
He tried yard signs. Nobody drove by.
He tried a nice-looking website. People left.
He tried calling people back the next morning. They'd already hired someone else.
And answer every call, even at nine P.M., with an A.I. receptionist.
Horizon Scales. Websites, ads, and A.I. receptionists.
